newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Manila to provide legal aid to maid over murder.
newsitem.headline: Manila to provide legal aid to maid over murder.

text.p: The Philippines will provide a lawyer to a Filipina maid arrested on suspicion of murdering her sister-in-law, an official said on Monday.

Consul-General Victoriano Lecaros told Reuters he met for about five minutes with Edna Sumawang, who has been detained at the Changi prison hospital for psychiatric evaluation after the killing of Anita Fuggan.
"We have engaged a lawyer," Lecaros said. "I informed her that we will help her with her legal problem."
He said murder was not discussed during the meeting because it was still under investigation, but that Sumawang said she had a difficult time adjusting to life in Singapore.
The next court hearing of the case will be on June 13.

Fuggan's murder raised uncomfortable memories of the row triggered by Singapore's execution of Filipina maid Flor Contemplacion in 1995, which nearly led to a rupture in ties between the two neighbours.
Sources close to the new case said both sides were treating it with great caution because of that row.
